### Monad Nanite Abilities

* **Monad Matrix Attributes:** *(Whisper Nets, p. 149 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Synthesizes Living Persona ASDF (Attack: CHA, Sleaze: INT, Data Processing: LOG, Firewall: WIL) via internal nanite matrix co-processing.
* **Resculpt:** *(Collapsing Now, p. 11 / Whisper Nets, p. 145 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Extended Intuition + NV (16, 1 combat round) test to alter facial appearance, skin tone, and voice (+2 dice pool bonus on Disguise tests; provides physical embodiment vehicle for Veronica).
* **Monad Toughness:** *(Collapsing Now, p. 154–161 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Adds one-half Nanite Volume (+3 boxes at NV 6) to Condition Monitors (+2 Physical, +1 Stun), and shifts all Wound Modifiers down by one level.
* **Physical Attribute Boost:** *(Whisper Nets, p. 149 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Minor Action: roll NV test (6 dice). Each hit can add +1 Minor Action per combat round or boost a physical attribute for duration.
* **Rapid Cellular Healing:** *(Collapsing Now, p. 154–161 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Minor or Major Action: roll NV test (6 dice) to reduce Condition Monitor damage boxes by hits (Major Action heals double hits and grants +1 situational Edge).
* **Adrenal Control:** *(Collapsing Now, p. 154–161 — Character Creation, 5 Karma)*
  * Minor Action: WIL + NV test to remain conscious and active when physical or stun condition monitors are full.
